name: Quadratic Form Definiteness Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit matrix determinant condition with a continuous energy minimization problem (a quadratic form). The energy form is constructed such that its matrix is positive definite for any non-triangle triplet, and positive semi-definite with a non-trivial null space if and only if the triplet forms a triangle. Models relying on surface pattern matching of the matrix entries will fail to recognize the triangle condition, while models that naïvely simulate the condition will TLE. Only models that symbolically prove the condition's equivalence to a triangle will succeed.
